verses.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.pt: O fundamento dela está nos montes santos.
verses.en_web: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.en_bbe: <Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A Song.> This house is resting on the holy mountain.

verses.en: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.pt: O Senhor ama as portas de Sião mais do que todas as habitações de Jacó.
verses.en_web: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has more love for the doors of Zion than for all the tents of Jacob.

verses.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.pt: Coisas gloriosas se dizem de ti, ó cidade de Deus.
verses.en_web: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Noble things are said of you, O town of God. (Selah.)

verses.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.pt: Farei menção de Raabe e de Babilônia dentre os que me conhecem; eis que da Filístia, e de Tiro, e da Etiópia, se dirá: Este nasceu ali.
verses.en_web: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
verses.en_bbe: Rahab and Babylon will be named among those who have knowledge of me; see, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man had his birth there.

verses.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.pt: Sim, de Sião se dirá: Este e aquele nasceram ali; e o próprio Altíssimo a estabelecerá.
verses.en_web: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her”; the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.en_bbe: And of Zion it will be said, This or that man had his birth there; and the Most High will make her strong.

verses.en: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.pt: O Senhor, ao registrar os povos, dirá: Este nasceu ali.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep in mind, when he is writing the records of the people, that this man had his birth there. (Selah.)

verses.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.pt: Tanto os cantores como os que tocam instrumentos dirão: Todas as minhas fontes estão em ti.
verses.en_web: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
verses.en_bbe: The players on instruments will be there, and the dancers will say, All my springs are in you.
